title: MaleTheme Solo #020 · 남 V자 보디빌더·피치 듀이·소방관 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a blooming lavender field in neat rows under a clear sky with a gravel path, a wooden gate and fence of normal height, warmly lit by the low golden sun, long soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in warm golden-hour sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Turkish man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, soft peach-pink eyeshadow, subtly glossy lips and a dewy highlight on the cheekbones, fair olive skin with a warm undertone, a gentle soft smile, soft rose-gold hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large bronze hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a lead small flared temple bell, a silver teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked platinum rings. Extremely long square nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a red-and-yellow firefighter helmet with a clear visor pushed up, yellow reflective-striped suspenders running over his bare shoulders and chest, and a minimal glossy red T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel and a yellow reflective stripe, on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him.
SUBJECT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme black platform high-heel mules, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the warm low sun in glowing glints, the golden light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
